tools.name: search_domains
tools.description: Search the live 199.domains inventory of brandable and keyword domain names for sale at fixed prices ($29 to $199). Pass what the person is building (e.g. 'ai sales agent', 'fitness app', 'stock trading', 'developer tool') and optional filters. Returns real listings only, each with its price and buy

tools.name: get_domain
tools.description: Look up one domain on 199.domains: whether it is for sale, sold or not listed, its fixed price (no added fees), buy URL, a short summary, the buying terms, and similar names for sale.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List the curated collections on 199.domains (by extension, price band, naming style and industry, e.g. AI agent, fintech, health, developer tools) with live listing counts. Use a slug as the collection filter in search_domains.
